_notes: Hand-labeled relevance for the five assignment judge queries. IMPORTANT: image IDs below are for the Fashionpedia subset. After switching to --source mixed (CUHK-PEDES+COCO), re-label against the new corpus before trusting P/R numbers. relevant = acceptable top results; hard_negatives = near-misses that should rank below true matches.

queries.query: A person in a bright yellow raincoat.
queries.label_notes: No literal bright-yellow raincoat in corpus. Relevant = bright yellow / yellow-green outerwear (coat/jacket). Hard negatives = raincoats that are blue or green (right garment family, wrong color).

queries.query: Professional business attire inside a modern office.
queries.label_notes: Corpus has almost no true office interiors; relevant = formal/business suit+tie attire (event/street/runway proxies including 648/655). Hard negatives = casual street/hoodie looks.

queries.query: Someone wearing a blue shirt sitting on a park bench.
queries.label_notes: 3482: blue t-shirt in park. 665: blue blouse in park. Hard negatives: park/bench without blue shirt, or blue shirt on city street.

queries.query: Casual weekend outfit for a city walk.
queries.label_notes: Relevant = casual street / jeans / hoodie / city walk looks. Hard negatives = formal suit+tie.

queries.query: A red tie and a white shirt in a formal setting.
queries.label_notes: Relevant requires BOTH white shirt AND red/maroon tie. Hard negatives = white shirt with black/non-red tie (compositional swap / missing red binding).
